sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins, will look to maintain their momentum at home against Alsager Town on Saturday. Alsager arrive in poor form with just one win in their last ten games and currently prop up the bottom of the division, making this a golden opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead further.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tricky away trip to Dawley Town and will be keen to close the two-point gap to leaders Sandbach with a win. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in a mid-table battle, while fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals—just three points behind the leaders—travel to Wednesfield Community in a fixture that could shake up the top four. Bilston Town's strong recent form sees them challenge for promotion at home to Foley Meir. Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a clash between mid-table teams, while Barnton's mixed recent record contrasts with Shawbury's alarming four-game losing streak. New Mills' inconsistency continues as they visit Market Drayton Town, both teams struggling to find consistent form in the middle-to-lower reaches of the table. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, who sit bottom with just two points from seven games and severe goal-difference issues, making this one of the division's most lopsided fixtures on paper. Crewe, also among the strugglers, face Allscott Heath at home in another lower-table encounter. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads, winless in five games, travel to Telford Town in a basement six-pointer where both sides desperately need a positive result.
